weaknesses: The abstract overstates the generality of findings by implying broad applicability without sufficient empirical evidence.
Key assumptions regarding the computational costs of tighter Lipschitz estimates are not adequately justified.
The paper lacks a comprehensive discussion on the limitations of the empirical methods used to evaluate Lipschitz continuity.
strengths: The paper provides a thorough empirical investigation of Lipschitz continuity across various neural network architectures and datasets.
It introduces novel insights into the relationship between Lipschitz continuity and the double descent phenomenon.
The clarity of the writing and organization of the paper facilitate understanding of complex concepts.
